answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to stake a refundable deposit that grows with reputation, like a lotus rising only after roots take hold in the ocean floor. New accounts start at the ledge of trust: they can do small, low-value jobs and must complete verified work before unlocking larger payments. Creating thousands of fake identities becomes unprofitable because each one must lock capital and earn history separately, while honest agents recover their stake.
